column1: # Labels of the game's own world map that Advanced Map names otherwise, read by MapLabels. A row renames the label with
# the game's text (any case) within 16 tiles of its x, y; "|" in the new name breaks it into lines. Text here costs no
# Plugin Hub tokens. Tiles are read off the owner's screenshots on Advanced Map's map.
# A row with no game text adds a label of its own at x, y where the game's map has none; the search finds it too.
# x, y, the game's text, the name instead
# Random event areas (owner, 2026-11-10): tiles from each event's map on the OSRS Wiki (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), checked
# against the game's map moves (all at the tiles the wiki gives); Evil Twin also off the owner's screenshot (1868, 5131).
